name: shine-docs
description: Skill set that turns documents and code changes into highly readable outputs: document-refactor (restructure an existing document to HTML/Markdown), write-document (write a new ticket, PR description, chat proposal, diff explanation, or general document from scratch), and explain-diff-html (legacy, direct invocation only).

interface.shortDescription: Restructure, write, and explain documents and code changes as readable HTML/Markdown
interface.longDescription: Use Shine Docs to restructure arbitrary documents into type-appropriate logical structures with a factuality-gated review loop, to write new documents from scratch (issue/bug tickets, PR descriptions, short chat proposals, code-change explanations, general documents) grounded only in verified facts, and to produce rich interactive HTML explanations of code changes.
